release.body:
## What's Changed
* test(ci): stop the debug-recording probe from starting the manager by @d4rken in https://github.com/d4rken-org/porter/pull/148
* fix(manager): show the new service's protocol right after an update by @d4rken in https://github.com/d4rken-org/porter/pull/149
* fix(manager): stop requesting Porter's client permission by @d4rken in https://github.com/d4rken-org/porter/pull/150
* fix(ci): narrow the foreign-signer replacement gap by @d4rken in https://github.com/d4rken-org/porter/pull/152
* fix(manager): show a refused service's protocol without reopening the screen by @d4rken in https://github.com/d4rken-org/porter/pull/153
* fix(i18n): complete translations across all 36 locales by @d4rken in https://github.com/d4rken-org/porter/pull/154
* feat(server): log why the Shizuku import leaves apps out by @d4rken in https://github.com/d4rken-org/porter/pull/157
* fix(ci): wait for the secondary user's HOME on Android 16+ before probing denial by @d4rken in https://github.com/d4rken-org/porter/pull/156
* fix(manager): clarify compatibility import result counts by @d4rken in https://github.com/d4rken-org/porter/pull/151
* fix(ci): give the Android 17 emulator jobs more memory by @d4rken in https://github.com/d4rken-org/porter/pull/158


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/d4rken-org/porter/compare/v0.8.0-rc0...v0.8.1-rc0
